parties: Lebnitze Real Estate Private Limited (acquirer); CESC Limited (target)
headline: CESC Limited: Takeover Disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) by Lebnitze Real Estate Private Limited
sum: Lebnitze Real Estate Private Limited has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) for CESC Limited. The filing is a post-announcement regulatory step; consideration, shareholding threshold crossed, and deal structure remain unpublished in available sources.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure indicates that the acquirer crossed a mandatory shareholding threshold (likely 25% or higher) and has formally notified the stock exchange; partners should verify the exact threshold, open-offer trigger status, and timeline to board approval via the full SEBI/NSE/BSE filings.
detail: Lebnitze Real Estate Private Limited submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 22 June 2026 regarding a substantial acquisition of CESC Limited shares. CESC Limited is a leading power distribution and generation utility serving Kolkata and parts of West Bengal and Odisha. Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 mandates disclosure when certain shareholding thresholds are crossed. The exact shareholding percentage, consideration value, and open-offer timeline are not disclosed in the primary source.
